title: Verifiable On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful approach for improving language-model reasoning, but its supervision is inherently sparse: a sequence-level verifier reward is propagated only through sampled trajectories and provides no direct signal for alternative actions. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a complementary form of supervision by providing dense teacher feedback over the full next-token distribution, but this signal is not grounded in verified task outcomes. Simply co-optimizing the two objectives does not couple these signals: verifier feedback remains sparse and does not inform the dense teacher supervision. We introduce Verifiable On-Policy Distillation (VOPD), which transfers sparse verifier feedback into dense, verifier-grounded supervision. translated_title: 可验证的在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升语言模型推理能力的强大方法，但其监督信号本质上是稀疏的：序列级验证器奖励只能通过采样的轨迹进行传播，无法为其他可选动作提供直接信号。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）则提供了一种互补的监督形式，通过在整个下一词元分布上提供密集的教师反馈，但这一信号并未建立在经过验证的任务结果之上。简单地共同优化这两个目标并不能将这两种信号耦合起来：验证器反馈依然稀疏，且无法为密集的教师监督提供信息。我们提出了可验证在线策略蒸馏（VOPD），它将稀疏的验证器反馈转化为密集的、以验证器为依据的监督信号。我们的关键观察是，OPD的隐式奖励视角能够将教师监督和验证器反馈置于一个共同的奖励空间中，同时保留……
tldr: VOPD通过将OPD的隐式奖励与验证器反馈置于共同的奖励空间，将稀疏的验证器反馈转化为密集的、以验证结果为依据的教师监督，从而更有效地提升语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: VOPD couples sparse verifier feedback with dense teacher supervision by placing both signals in a common implicit reward space, enabling verifier-grounded dense supervision that more effectively improves language-model reasoning.
